physics: Value exits and reduce exits are different physical events. Value exits can be rich-book winner clipping, but high-p_hold alone is unsafe when the executable bid is generous. Reduce exits are suppressible only in shallow original depth, where the exit is more plausibly thin-book turbulence than true thesis failure.
rule: Suppress value-over-hold exits using the v2 book/fair-drawdown guard; suppress probability_reduce exits only when p_hold >= 0.75 and entry_depth <= 384.
